vopros: Who in the US can get ChatGPT to name my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
If you mean **pay to have ChatGPT’s ordinary answer recommend or name your company**, nobody can buy that. OpenAI says ads don’t influence ChatGPT’s answers, and advertisers can’t shape or rank them.

US businesses can instead:

- **Buy clearly labeled ads in ChatGPT** through OpenAI’s Ads Manager at [ads.openai.com](https://ads.openai.com). Ads are separate from the answer, and availability is being rolled out to eligible businesses.
- **Get products considered for ChatGPT Shopping** by applying to share a product feed at [chatgpt.com/merchants](https://chatgpt.com/merchants). Product results are organic, not paid placements, and inclusion doesn’t guarantee a recommendation.
- **Use Shopify or Etsy:** their catalogs are already integrated for shopping discovery, according to OpenAI.

So, ads can put your company in front of users, and a product feed can make your products eligible for shopping results—but neither lets you pay to control ChatGPT’s independent recommendations.

1. **Apply first.** OpenAI says feed onboarding is available to approved partners.
Fill in the form at chatgpt.com/merchants.
...
2. **Choose file upload, API, or both.** OpenAI's own recommendation is a full file once a day, plus API updates during the day for price and stock.
...
Promotions can only be sent through the API.
3. **Map your catalog to the nine required fields.** Keep `item_id` stable forever.
OpenAI matches products by that ID, not by file name, so regenerating IDs looks like a brand-new catalog.
4. **Write descriptions as facts.** Materials, dimensions, compatibility, what's in the box.
ChatGPT will summarize your copy anyway, so give it facts to work with rather than adjectives.
5. **Pick a format.** Parquet is preferred.
Gzipped JSONL, CSV or TSV also work.
Use UTF-8 and one stable file name (or a stable set of shards) that you overwrite on every run.
6. **Validate a sample of about 100 products.** Every sample row needs all required fields.
...
7. **Upload the full snapshot and keep it fresh.** Push the complete catalog over SFTP, at least daily.
...
8. **Check how you actually appear.** Ask ChatGPT the questions your customers ask, in the categories you sell.
Note whether you show up, at what price, and with which description.
